svg.title: RoverBuddy X1 proposed power and signal wiring
svg.desc: Separate Pi, pan and tilt supplies; two independently regulated motor branches behind the hardware drive cutoff; U2D2 serial pan control and GP11 tilt PWM. Planning diagram, not a validated assembly schematic.
svg.text: Current CAD candidates • Planned connections • Hardware and interface checks remain open
Ratings, exact parts and fault/re-arm behavior to be selected
Auxiliary supplies feed the Pi, XM430 pan and D645MW tilt.
The drive cutoff does not isolate the head actuators.
Head stop behavior remains to be specified.
Common ground reference required. Keep separate positive rails separate; actuator returns use their own power wiring.
USB data also links Pi to Pico
Other Pi interfaces: chest display via HDMI + USB touch; audio via USB. Head-control firmware is not implemented.
Common reference; not actuator power return
GP10 is unassigned for the current pan design. Pin references apply to the official Pico 2 with Headers (SC1632).
Planning diagram, not a validated pin-to-pin assembly schematic. Source and remaining checks: docs/WIRING.md
